verdict.rationale: Serverless functions or containers are a fair question for a cloud platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions a first-party functions or serverless container service, or any triggers, limits or cold-start behavior. The pack covers only the CLI, SDKs, the REST API, Terraform, IAM, budgets, free-tier compute VMs and AI release notes, none of which is serverless execution.

support.subject: As a developer, small services need no servers — first-party functions/serverless containers with documented triggers, limits, and cold-start behavior
